description: This Java class defines a custom exception MessageTimeoutException used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate a message timeout scenario. It includes constructors, builder pattern implementation, JSON deserialization, and references to related classes and constants.

classes.name: MessageTimeoutException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing a message timeout error with associated metadata and builder pattern.

classes.name: MessageTimeoutException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of MessageTimeoutException with a fluent API.

methods.name: MessageTimeoutException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with headers, message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Static method returning a new Builder instance, optionally initialized with a timeout.

methods.description: Deprecated static method creating an exception from a message string.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Static method creating an exception from a message string and headers.

methods.description: Static method to deserialize the exception from a JSON object and headers.
